setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 4, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (4, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]
df['title'] = [f'item_{i:04d}' for i in range(n)]

steps.name: set color column to cluster (default palette for deterministic colours)
steps.eval: const col = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'cluster'); a.view.palette = 'default'; a.setColorColumn(col.index);
steps.until: a.colorColumn !== null && a.colorMeta !== null && a.colorsAll !== null

steps.name: set title and add an annotation
steps.eval: a.titleOverlay.title = 'Test Atlas'; a.titleOverlay.subtitle = '3k points'; a.annotations.set('ann1', { id: 'ann1', text: 'grp_0 cluster', style: 'plain', worldX: 0, worldY: 0, offsetX: 20, offsetY: -20, color: '#cccccc' });

steps.name: run html export dark
steps.eval: const titleCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'title'); const clusterCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'cluster'); a.exportHtml({ tooltipColumns: [titleCol.index, clusterCol.index], linkColumn: -1, maxChars: 200, embedImages: false, samplePct: 100 })

openPageSteps.name: viewer loaded with correct point count
legend swatches have colours (CSS injected)
openPageSteps.assert: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.legend-sw')).some(s => { const c = getComputedStyle(s).backgroundColor; return c && c !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && c !== 'transparent' && c !== 'rgb(0, 0, 0)'; })

steps.name: set light background and export again
steps.eval: h.htmlExport = undefined; a.view.background = '#f0f0f0'; a.htmlExportOpen = true; const titleCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'title'); a.exportHtml({ tooltipColumns: [titleCol.index], linkColumn: -1, maxChars: 200, embedImages: false, samplePct: 100 })

openPageSteps.name: legend swatches have colours in light theme
openPageSteps.assert: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.legend-sw')).some(s => { const c = getComputedStyle(s).backgroundColor; return c && c !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && c !== 'transparent'; })
